decisions.decision: The inline-edit/cancel path re-reads via the existing manualcharge.Reader (ListEntriesByAccount) and filters by id in memory; we do NOT add a GetEntry(ctx, accountID, id) getter to the archived tier-1 manualcharge.Reader.
decisions.why: Module isolation — reopening the archived manualcharge module for a convenience getter is outside the gateway tier and unwarranted; the edit path is low-frequency and the list is limit-capped. Worker flagged GetEntry as optional; declined.

decisions.decision: templ codegen runs via `go run github.com/a-h/templ/cmd/templ generate ./...` (templ is a go.mod dep, not installed on PATH); the worker runs it plus `go build ./...` and `go test ./internal/gateway/...` to verify — not handed to the user.
decisions.why: Project override (CLAUDE.md) authorizes codegen (sqlc generate) and go build/test for this repo; templ generate is the analogous codegen step. The artifacts' cautious 'user runs templ generate' note is superseded for this project.

decisions.decision: The whole tier-2 change (tasks A-I, a linear dependency chain within the single gateway module touching shared files handlers/gateway.go/templates) is implemented by ONE serial worker dispatch rather than 7 per-wave workers.
decisions.why: Pipeline default batches into one serial worker to read the doc pack once and amortize setup; tasks are interdependent and share files, so parallelism is unsafe and per-wave re-dispatch would re-read the doc pack ~7x. Budget is ample (5h 2%, ctx 5%).
